archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY fused with MODERN JAPANESE EDITORIAL (Wabi-sabi Clean + Crimson Kinetic)
emotional_tone: Inviting, motivating, focused, clear Indonesian pedagogical warmth with genuine Japanese aesthetic craft (washi off-white, vermilion torii red, deep sumi ink, soft matcha green accents)

typography.font_family_heading: Plus Jakarta Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Hiragino Sans', sans-serif

colors.palette_notes: Warm Washi Beige base (#FDFBF7), Deep Sumi Charcoal (#18181B) for ink legibility, Vermilion / Torii Crimson (#DC2626 / #BE123C) for kinetic focus/badges/active states, Matcha Slate (#059669) for success/Nihongo 1 mastery, Indigo Navy (#1E293B) for Nihongo 2 mastery.

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand tagline + learning streak stats left, quick entry into Bab Materi & Interactive Quiz right
entry_surfaces./bab: bento grid — curriculum selector (MNN 1: Bab 1-25 / MNN 2: Bab 26-50) with active Bab 1 card and locked Bab 2-50 badges
entry_surfaces./bab/:babId: 4-tab Japanese study sanctum — Bunpo (grammar formula), Kotoba (vocabulary with furigana + examples), Kanji (strokes, Onyomi/Kunyomi, Jukugo), Kaiwa (interactive script dialogue with audio/furigana)
entry_surfaces./quiz: quiz setup console — scope selection (Bab 1 / MNN 1 / MNN 2 / Custom) and 5 quiz modes (Bunpo MCQ, Kanji Reader, Kotoba ID-JP, Mixed, Duolingo Word Reordering)
entry_surfaces./quiz/runner: distraction-free focus stage — top animated progress bar, interactive ruby question/word blocks, instant pedagogical explanation drawer with particle highlighter
entry_surfaces./quiz/results: achievement breakdown — circular score gauge, review incorrect answers, streak multiplier, and 'Ulangi / Kembali ke Bab' CTAs
entry_surfaces./stats: learner dashboard — JLPT mastery curve, total quiz sessions, Kotoba retained, and historical logs stored in MongoDB

visual_enhancers.furigana_ruby_component: Custom <FuriganaText text='...' /> parser supporting standard notation e.g. [私|わたし] or direct <ruby>Kanji<rt>furigana</rt></ruby> with custom CSS ensuring 1.8rem minimum line-height and crisp crimson/sumi contrast.
visual_enhancers.duolingo_reorder_ui: Tactile bouncy word block tokens with 3D bottom border (border-b-4 border-zinc-300 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-1) for word rearrangement quiz.
visual_enhancers.interactive_grammar_cards: Grammar formula highlight with clickable particle chips (は, が, を, に, で, も, から, まで) revealing grammatical function tooltips.
visual_enhancers.tactile_audio_speech: Web Speech Synthesis API for Japanese (ja-JP) audio pronunciation on Kotoba & Kaiwa lines.
visual_enhancers.washi_paper_texture: Subtle 1px border with soft inner shadow and warm cream backdrop.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Tetris-style bento: Hero motivation card (col-span-full lg:col-span-8), Quick Quiz CTA + Streak Card (col-span-full lg:col-span-4), MNN 1 & 2 Book Progress (2 columns), Recent Quiz Activity List.
layouts_and_grids.bab_detail_layout: Header sticky breadcrumb with Bab 1 badge, Title in Japanese & Indonesian, Tab Bar (Bunpo, Kotoba, Kanji, Kaiwa) with instant search filter, and sticky bottom quiz CTA.
layouts_and_grids.quiz_runner_layout: Clean centered single-column mobile-first layout (max-w-2xl mx-auto) with animated progress bar at top, question prompt with ruby characters, option cards / Duolingo word bank, and slide-up interactive feedback bottom sheet.

motion.transitions: transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, opacity 0.2s ease
motion.word_chip_spring: motion.button with hover lift y: -2, tap y: 2
motion.feedback_sheet_spring: motion.div entrance from bottom y: 40 to 0 with spring stiffness 300 damping 25

accessibility.contrast_check: All text elements verified against APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio (Sumi #18181B on Washi #FDFBF7 = 16.2:1 contrast; Crimson #DC2626 on White = 4.8:1; Muted #52525B on Washi = 5.2:1).
accessibility.screen_reader_ruby: <ruby aria-label='Kanji reading'> tag structure with fallback parentheses text for legacy screen readers.
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full arrow key navigation and 1-4 number keys for MCQ quiz selection; Enter to submit/continue.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this design_guidelines.json carefully before coding.

2. Database & API: Backend is FastAPI with MongoDB. Bab 1 data (Bunpo, Kotoba, Kanji, Kaiwa) MUST be seeded in MongoDB and served via /api/bab/1. Bab 2-50 should be returned in metadata with is_locked: true and badge 'Segera'.

3. Quiz System: 5 quiz modes must be fully functional: 1) Bunpo MCQ with particle options, 2) Kanji reading guessing, 3) Kotoba ID<->JP translation, 4) Campuran (mixed), 5) Duolingo-style click-to-reorder word blocks into a grammatical Japanese sentence.

4. Explanations in Quiz: When answering Bunpo, display an interactive breakdown (highlighting the formula e.g. '[Kata Benda] + は + [Kata Benda] + です', key particle meaning, and common trap explanation).

5. Furigana ruby annotations: Ensure all Japanese sentences in Bunpo, Kotoba, Kanji, and Kaiwa use HTML <ruby> <rt> tag or custom parser so furigana is placed cleanly ABOVE the Kanji without colliding with adjacent lines.

6. Quiz results & Statistics: After quiz completion, calculate score, accuracy, time spent, and save the session to MongoDB via POST /api/quiz/sessions. Display total quizzes taken, average score, and streak on the Dashboard.
7. Degrade gracefully: Never crash or show full-screen blank page if backend is disconnected; show polished skeletons and fallback offline preview for Bab 1.

8. All interactive elements (buttons, tabs, quiz choices, word blocks, navigation links) MUST have clear `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid='tab-bunpo'`, `data-testid='quiz-option-0'`, `data-testid='duolingo-word-chip'`).
9. Retain mobile-first layout with smooth tab transitions and clean desktop dual-column layouts.
